long_biography.plain_text:
Andrew Donald Gumberg leads Gumberg Asset Management, the retail-property company based in Fort Lauderdale. Born on 6 January 1958 to Stanley and Marcia Gumberg, he entered a family with deep property roots. His grandfather founded its business, and his father developed it into a major shopping-centre portfolio. He studied at the University of Pittsburgh and Penn State University.

His firm advises institutional owners and investors, with experience spanning hundreds of properties across the United States. Beyond its asset-management work, Gumberg has acted as a shopping-centre owner, trustee and loan sponsor. These roles have kept him involved in both operational decisions and the ownership structures behind retail properties.

His firm advises institutional owners and investors, with experience spanning hundreds of properties across the United States. Beyond its asset-management work, Gumberg has acted as a shopping-centre owner, trustee and loan sponsor. These roles have kept him involved in both operational decisions and the ownership structures behind retail properties.
